title: Upload
description: Selects files by button or drag and drop, validates them and lists them with their transfer state. The transfer itself stays in your code.

basic.title: Single file
basic.description: onFilesSelected receives files that pass accept and maxSize; reflect the transfer in value. replace lets a new file replace the current one.

multiple.title: Multiple files
multiple.description: multiple with maxCount; failed items show their error and a retry button when onRetry is set.

UploadProps.label: Visible label of the upload field (also names the file input)
UploadProps.value: Files to list, with their transfer state (controlled)
UploadProps.onFilesSelected: Called with the selected (or dropped) files once they pass accept, maxSize and maxCount. Transfer, cancellation and persisted URLs belong to the caller
UploadProps.onRemove: Called to remove a file; shows a remove button on every item
UploadProps.onRetry: Called to retry a failed file; shows a retry button on failed items
UploadProps.accept: Accepted file types, as for <input accept>
UploadProps.replace: Single-file mode: lets a new file replace the listed one (the existing file does not count toward maxCount)
UploadProps.maxCount: Maximum number of files, including the listed ones
UploadProps.maxSize: Maximum size of a file, in bytes
UploadProps.loading: Busy state: blocks new selections and retries (removal stays possible) and sets aria-busy
UploadProps.labels: Custom texts; each one overrides the localized default

UploadItem.name: File name shown in the list
UploadItem.error: Error message shown when status is "error"
UploadItem.previewUrl: Image preview URL (e.g. an object URL)

UploadLabels.uploading: Status text of an uploading file
UploadLabels.done: Status text of an uploaded file
UploadLabels.failed: Status text of a failed file without its own error message
UploadLabels.tooMany: Error shown when too many files are selected
UploadLabels.invalidType: Error shown when a file does not match accept
UploadLabels.tooLarge: Error shown when a file exceeds maxSize
UploadLabels.retry: Accessible label of the retry button of a file
UploadLabels.remove: Accessible label of the remove button of a file

cssVars.--upload-gap: Space between the label, the dropzone, the error and the file list
cssVars.--upload-dropzone-radius: Corner radius of the dropzone (defaults to --radius-md)
cssVars.--upload-dropzone-border-color: Dashed border color of the dropzone at rest
cssVars.--upload-dropzone-background: Background of the dropzone at rest
cssVars.--upload-preview-width: Width of an image preview in the file list
cssVars.--upload-preview-height: Height of an image preview in the file list
